task.title: Planner: add a breakfast slot
task.description:
Owner decision (2026-11-18): the planner should plan breakfast as well as lunch and dinner. The original spec left breakfast out only because the owner does not plan it personally; Skip covers people who do not eat or plan breakfast. This settles the open 'breakfast' question in the as-built spec.

Wanted:
- Each day shows breakfast, lunch, dinner, in that order, with the same four types (Cook, Leftovers, Eat out, Skip).
- Enter/Next moves breakfast -> lunch -> dinner -> next day's breakfast.

Notes:
- planSlots.meal is currently lunch | dinner (convex/schema.ts, convex/lib/plannerValidators.ts, plannerRules.ts); the week query, leftovers look-back ordering, and slot-cell/planner-week components assume two meals a day.
- Open point to raise with the owner: someone who never plans breakfast would have to tap Skip seven times a week, or leave seven empty slots. Consider a planner setting for which meals are planned (or a default type per meal) so breakfast can be hidden or pre-skipped.
- Later slices (grocery list, nutrition day totals) must count breakfast.
